outreach_packet.subject_line: Live ops platform for studios—built by devs, for devs
outreach_packet.hook: Following your investment in Live Aware Labs and your focus on live service tools, I wanted to share how we're solving the operational side of the live services equation.

body_paragraphs.value_prop: We're building the live operations platform we wish we had when running live games—a unified system that handles content deployment, player segmentation, event orchestration, and real-time balancing without requiring engineering for every update. Transcend's focus on 'craftspeople at the top of their game' resonates with us; we're developers who got tired of rebuilding the same live ops stack at every studio. Our platform lets small teams operate like they have a 50-person live ops department.
body_paragraphs.market_insight: Your portfolio at Transcend includes some of the most innovative live service studios—Stress Level Zero, Ruckus Games, Methodical Games. You know that shipping the game is only 20% of the battle; operating it for years is where the real work (and revenue) happens. Your Live Aware Labs investment shows you understand that testing is critical pre-launch. We're solving the post-launch problem: the $22B+ that studios spend annually on fragmented live ops tools and manual processes. With your Kabam background, Andrew, you've felt this pain directly.
body_paragraphs.traction_ask: We're in closed beta with 3 studios and seeing 40% reduction in content deployment cycles. Given Transcend's thesis on live service tools and your recent Live Aware Labs investment, we'd value your perspective on our roadmap. Would you have 20 minutes to discuss how live ops infrastructure is becoming the critical layer for modern game development?
